tenderSchedule.title: KSDACOMCUG2026
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Closed User Group (CUG) Mobile Telephone Connections to the DoA Offices

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Authoraization letter as per Appendix A
Letter of Commitment as per Appendix B

UASL/CMTS License to set up and operate Cellular Services in India. They must have been operational with GSM based cellular services in the circle, Karnataka. Documentary proof issued by the competent authority (Government of India) in support of the points presence duly notarized should be provided.
Must be operational with GSM based Cellular Services with India/ Karnataka presence, with GSM technology.
Anti-Collusion Certificate as per Appendix C

Network Operation Center. The bidder must have facility for providing customer support and troubleshooting at locations where the Mobile Connections are required. Address and contact telephone numbers of the Contact/Customer Care Centre for the same should be provided along with the offer.

Experience certificate of similar contracts of at least 3 (three) CUG group of at least 1000 connections per contract for minimum one year either from public sector or Government sector as per Appendix D
